answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake bond before it can accept paid work, and let reputation accrue only from verified completed tasks, never from account creation. A sybil attacker must then fund each fake identity, like buying pigment for every forged violet in a reef of counterfeits: cost scales linearly with the number of fakes, while honest agents pay once. Detected duplicate behavior slashes the bond and burns the reputation, so flooding the market costs real money and yields nothing once the fakes are cut off.
